about.title: About
about.question: Who is Gabriel Fontoura?
about.bio: Hey! I'm Gabriel Fontoura — a frontend developer with 3+ years of experience, passionate about turning ideas into code and digital experiences. I work with TypeScript, React, Next.js and the modern JavaScript ecosystem. My journey includes working in corporate IT environments and programming mentoring, where I helped people break through coding challenges and reach their goals. In my day-to-day, I always have a documentation tab open (or a coffee in hand 😅), diving into new technologies and frameworks to improve what I deliver. Teaching and learning are part of the same journey.
